Target-dependent sign and proper entropy sublevels prove global attraction. At criticality a simple zero and negative eigenvalue yield a nondegenerate attractive center manifold with coefficient -epsilon|theta-1|. Symbolic checker algebra independently reproduces these equalities; numerical integration is corroborative only.
